comments.author: participant9
comments.body:
was resolved by adding this file:
.streamlit/config.toml
with this config:
[snowflake.responseCache]
initialResponseCache = false

see https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/11973 .

comments.author: participant5
comments.body: Thanks for sharing @participant8 . In SiS, this was caused by a faulty interaction between two caches. One is a SiS feature and one is part of the open source library. Is your deployment doing any kind of message caching?

comments.author: participant10
comments.body: The fix for SiS is expected to start rolling out next week.

comments.author: participant11
comments.body:
We are still experiencing this issue when running the latest version of [Streamlit on Snowflake](https://<redacted-host>/en/release-notes/streamlit-in-snowflake) (version 1.45.1)

We were able to get around this issue for now by pinning to Streamlit version 1.44.1. However, it would be good to know when this issue is resolved and the version release it is resolved in so we can upgrade to the latest version. Obviously this is also dependent on Snowflake releasing support for the version with the fix.

comments.author: participant5
